BiblicalUsage: Pol is the bean, plump and plain, and it turns up twice in the story. Barzillai brings beans and lentils to feed David's people in the wilderness, and Ezekiel is told to take beans among the grains for the bread of his sign.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God feeds his people with plain food in hard places, and beans on a list are as much his provision as manna.
